generate_random_colors: generate N visually distinct random colors in HSV space and convert them to RGB tuples
encode_image_to_base64: encode an image file from disk into a base64 string for storage or transmission
decode_base64_to_image: decode a base64 encoded string back into a PIL Image in RGB color mode
find_closest_color_name: find the closest named CSS3 color for a given RGB color tuple by Euclidean distance
annotate_image_with_xyz_coords: draw 3D coordinate labels and red marker points on a PIL image at specified centers
